key_insight: A dual-resonator silver microcavity enhances sensitizer absorption and directs upconverted emission, increasing detected solid-state upconversion output.
engineering_relevance: This optical design could help photovoltaics harvest sub-bandgap photons without increasing sensitizer loading and associated aggregation quenching.
method: Thermally co-evaporate a rubrene:PdPC active layer inside a planar silver microcavity.
Align a dispersive cavity mode with PdPC absorption at 665 nm and 32° incidence.
Use a second cavity mode to directionally outcouple upconverted emission.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 12-fold absorptance enhancement at 665 nm, alongside 22-fold peak and 4.5-fold integrated enhancements in detected upconversion emission.
watch_item: Angle-dependent resonance and cavity-induced reabsorption require careful optical integration; photovoltaic efficiency gains are not demonstrated in the abstract.
paper_title: Dual-Resonator Organic Microcavities for Triplet-Triplet Annihilation Upconversion
